name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.171: The seeder no longer starts when no library is selected.
    It already refused to queue anything without a selection, but only from
    inside the scan - reached after the global run lock was taken and the
    change-stamp pre-check had walked the library. A configuration with no
    library therefore still paid for a lock, a library walk and a database
    touch to arrive at "nothing to queue". The check now sits at the top of
    the seed step, ahead of the lock, and the worker row reads grey
    skipped/"no libraries selected" rather than a green run that found nothing.
